blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) on Friday expressed hope that the people of Mindanao “move forward together” in light of its recently concluded first Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary elections. “As the BARMM enters a new chapter, we appeal especially to its leaders: make the Bangsamoro a home for everyone. Let governance protect the dignity, rights and religious freedom of every person and community,” CBCP said in a statement. “May the peoples of Mindanao move forward together—not merely tolerating one another, but knowing one another, respecting one another and working side by […]...
